analogy.rationale: The annotated targets (CEL, FABP6, SLCO1C1) are not canonical GPCRs and are poorly expressed in these cell lines, so GPCR agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; other GPCR-targeting classes are the closest analogs, with receptor agonists sharing downstream signaling but also likely weak effects.
